fato_historico: 2000: Anti-globalization protests in Prague (some 20,000 protesters) turn violent during the IMF and World Bank summits.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a call to find peace amidst the noise. Much like the tides of global change, your personal world might feel stirred, yet you are the steady anchor. Consider channeling this restless energy into grounded creative projects. It is a good time to stand firm in your values while keeping your heart open to gentle, transformative growth.
frase_do_dia: True strength blooms when we remain calm in the eye of the storm.
significado_numero: Represents the balance between material success and deep emotional fulfillment.
conselho: Focus on what you can control and let the chaos fade away today.
